desc: The single guard registry. Positive polarity: each guard states the positive condition, named for what is true when it holds; no negated twins — consumers negate at the use site. Each guard carries expr (the machine-evaluable expression per INTERFACE.md, over schema.json, with bindings noted) — or, where the condition is judgment-shaped, an expr routing through ["adjudged", ...]. The prose desc and cite are annotation on the expr, never the content. Conditions that could not be fully compiled are cross-flagged in gaps.json.

guards.desc: no motion currently pending before the assembly
floor currently assigned to a member
no member currently has the floor
the act/motion m may be made while another member has the floor — from the registry interrupt attribute (Table t44-t45); conditional interrupts route through their per-record condition
recognition-preference claim asserted before the chair has recognized another
a multi-motion sequence toward one object is mid-flight; blocks unrelated intervening motions (e.g. take-from-table cannot interrupt it)
guards.note: the series' existence is announced/known state (e.g. table adopted 'until X', suspend-rules for a purpose); recorded as a history marker when the enabling motion's declared purpose creates it — see gaps.json (series-identity is declared at adoption, not inferred)

guards.desc: the immediately pending question is not debatable
the immediately pending question is neither debatable nor amendable; blocks previous-question
an order for the previous question covers motions not yet voted
an order closing debate on the main question at a set time/duration is in force (not a mere per-speech limit [15:10])

no unexhausted debate-limiting order blocks motion m: the previous question, once ordered, precludes all subsidiaries except lay-on-table [16:2]; an order closing debate at a set time precludes commit and postpone-to-certain-time [15:11]; a bare speech-length limitation precludes nothing [15:10]
a point of order, undebatable appeal, or a request/inquiry not adhering to the main question is pending; blocks lay-on-table
a suspend-the-rules touching priority of business is pending; blocks call-for-orders-of-the-day

motion m is legitimately incidental to a pending motion, a question just pending, or business at hand; structural windows in precedence.json table/applicability decide the listed incidentals; the residual arises-out-of test is adjudicated
guards.note: consult precedence.json table/applicability first: rows for objection-to-consideration, division-of-assembly (window), etc. compile the structural part; this guard is the residual

guards.desc: no debate yet on the main question and no subsidiary except lay-on-table stated; window for objection-to-consideration
from first vote cast until all have presumably voted; blocks interruption incl. adjourn
from result announcement until debate/business intervenes; window for division, retake motions, vote changes, points re the vote
the reconsider of question q's vote may still be made: same day or next business day of the session (no limit in committees)
eligibility to move reconsider: member voted with the prevailing side (committee: anyone not on the losing side [37:35]); recorded for roll-call, else established by member assertion
guards.note: computable subcases of 37:10(a) beyond roll-call: adoption by unanimous consent qualifies every member present at the adoption (compiled here as the method disjunct; presence-at-adoption refinement needs per-event presence history — gaps.json); an irrelevant-negative adoption [44:9(a)] qualifies all present who did not vote in favor (same presence-history dependency); a ballot voter qualifies only by waiving ballot secrecy — that waiver is the prevailing-side-claim assertion route

guards.desc: temporarily but not finally disposed of; blocks conflicting/duplicate main motions and later-session renewal
a substantially-same question was finally disposed of this session; blocks renewal except via bring-back motions
progress in business/debate has made the motion a new question
target time within the horizon: end of next regular session when within quarterly-interval, else end of present session; and not tantamount to killing the question

next regular business session begins within quarterly-interval AND no specified portion of the membership ends its term before then (referral to committee is the sole carryover channel when this fails [9:8, 9:10])

effect fully executed or impossible to undo; contract with notified party; resignation acted on / election-or-expulsion result with person present or notified; or reachable instead by a live reconsider

t tainted votes (excluded members or improper inclusions), assigned adversarially, reach the margin of the announced result — exact for majority thresholds; other thresholds analogous per voting.json threshold_evaluation (the comparison retargets to that threshold's expression)
required for validity of all substantive action; limited motion set allowed absent it (fix-time, adjourn, recess, measures to obtain a quorum)
the motion is an abuse of form; chair's duty-veto, an absolute filter above all admission rules
the named rule may be suspended: its class is suspendible (rules.json suspendibility) and no unsuspendable category covers it (rules.json unsuspendable)
guards.note: unsuspendable_matches: category membership is content classification — an input recorded per rule (rules.json unsuspendable categories); see gaps.json

guards.desc: the act is in order under the rule resolved via the authority order, applying interpretation principles on ambiguity; the resolution procedure is rules.json resolution, with adjudicated interpretive steps
guards.note: governing_rules_forbidding is the rules.json resolution procedure applied to the act — a derived query over rules_state; ambiguity routes through adjudication (society-decides [56:68(1)])

guards.desc: the adopted act falls under a null-and-void ground (rules.json continuing_breach_grounds); point of order remains timely while the breach continues
guards.note: ground-matching is content classification per rules.json continuing_breach_grounds — the classification is an adjudicated/recorded input; see gaps.json

guards.desc: a scheduled item is eligible for take-up under the dispatch algorithm
guards.note: compiled in scheduler.json; this registry entry names and routes it

guards.desc: the scheduled item may interrupt the pending question, per the preemption exceptions
guards.note: compiled in scheduler.json; this registry entry names and routes it

guards.desc: the target time is within the scheduling horizon

a motion to suspend the rules for a substantially-same purpose was voted down at this meeting; renewal is barred until after an adjournment (even to a same-day meeting), except by unanimous consent — any number of suspensions for different purposes remain fine

functions.desc: returns the adoption/amendment/rescission threshold alternatives for a rule, per class (rules.json change_thresholds); a function, not a predicate
